one ALB, node in AZ B
RDS = relational data (users, orders, payments: JOIN, ACID). DynamoDB = non-relational (sessions, cart, catalog, IoT) accessed through DAX.
DynamoDB is a regional serverless service outside the VPC: reached through a VPC Gateway Endpoint (traffic stays on the AWS network).
NACL per subnet tier (stateless) + Security Group chain (stateful): ALB -> app -> cache / db.
